headline: SDP @ PHI matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is SDP 3.40 at PHI 3.33, with a projected total of 6.74. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward SDP: SDP moved +0.60 runs while PHI moved +0.25, changing the projected margin by +0.35 runs. The projected total climbed +0.85, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -17.5%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Randy Vásquez has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.2 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Fernando Tatis Jr., Brandon Marsh, Kyle Schwarber, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Adolis García, Bryce Johnson because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
